items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: John was interviewed via Zoom on September 14, 2023 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: John was interviewed via Zoom on September 14, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a great pleasure to have John Altman with me today, from one continent to the other.
